message.content:
Re-integrate the 5 Soul Pilates "Ideas" features onto the CURRENTLY-DEPLOYED live code so deploying them can't revert the recently-shipped Google-login / privacy+terms / hero / TikTok work. Server **51.79.226.200** (.NET + Astro). Merge + compile-verify + push ONLY — do NOT deploy/build-images/restart/touch running containers, no Mongo writes.

## Access (SAFE method — never print the plaintext password)
ssh2/sftp to .200 via the platform approach (decrypt `server.rootPasswordEnc` for server id `cmsc9l72y000ghl7iyd87u5ja`; mirror lib/sftp.ts; use ssh2-sftp-client for uploads if stdin streaming hangs). ASSERT `hostname -I` contains 51.79.226.200 before EVERY command.

## The problem to fix
`origin/integration/sp-ideas-batch` (`9a3a285`, the 5 features) was branched off an OLD `origin/main` (`74e3bac`), which is BEFORE the live Google-auth/legal/hero/TikTok commits. The live prod is running the `feature/tiktok-fix` line (google-auth + /privacy + /terms + hero-removal + tiktok fix). Deploying the batch as-is would drop those. Fix by re-integrating.

## Steps
1. Determine the **currently-deployed live commit**: on the box, `git -C /opt/soulpilates fetch origin`, and identify the HEAD the live prod is running (check `/opt/soulpilates` main / the last deployed tree; it should be the `feature/tiktok-fix` content — verify it contains the google-auth controller, /privacy + /terms pages, the `Soul Pilates · Da Nang` h1, and the `@soulpilates.vn` tiktok link). Call this LIVE.
2. Create a worktree branch **`deploy/sp-ideas-live`** off LIVE: `git -C /opt/soulpilates worktree add /opt/soulpilates-wt-reintg -b deploy/sp-ideas-live <LIVE-commit>`.
3. **Merge `origin/integration/sp-ideas-batch`** into it. Both descend from `74e3bac`, so this combines the live web/auth work with the 5 back-office features. UNION-resolve any conflict — keep BOTH sides (the two sets touch mostly different files; do NOT drop either the google/legal/tiktok/hero changes OR any of the 5 features). After resolving, verify present: google-auth routes, /privacy + /terms, `@soulpilates.vn` tiktok, no hero-lede; AND revenue-forecast, show-rate, split-payments, duo-private, attendee-quantity stepper.
4. **Compile-verify** in throwaway `--rm` containers (no deploy image build, no restart): `dotnet build SoulPilates.API -c Release` in `mcr.microsoft.com/dotnet/sdk:10.0` → 0 errors (ignore pre-existing SoulPilates.Tests stub errors); `npm ci && npm run build` in `node:22-alpine` → success (~59 pages). If a real conflict-induced bug appears, fix minimally and note it.
5. Commit + push `deploy/sp-ideas-live` to origin; verify the push stuck (re-push if the box's automation resets it). Remove the worktree + prune. Clean up helper scripts on /opt/nxeon.

## Report
The LIVE base commit you used (and confirmation it had google/legal/tiktok/hero), the merge result + any conflicts resolved, the compile-verify results, a checklist that BOTH the live web/auth work AND all 5 features are present on `deploy/sp-ideas-live`, the branch tip, and the exact prod deploy command for the user: `cd /opt/soulpilates && git fetch origin && git checkout -B main origin/deploy/sp-ideas-live && scripts/deploy-prod.sh`.
